source_snapshot.message:
fix(php): scope use to its namespace block, and stop double-emitting calls

Two further regressions against main, both measured rather than inferred.

1. A use leaked across braced namespace blocks. phpFqcnImportsByLocal is
   keyed by file, but a use is scoped to its namespace block. Given

     namespace A { use Vendor[local-path]\Thing; function run(Thing $t) {...} }
     namespace B { class Thing {} function go(Thing $t) {...} }

   go() resolved to Vendor/Package/Thing.php at 0.9, though B declares its
   own Thing right there. main emits no edge for go at all. One namespace per
   file is the PSR-12 norm, so the index now skips a multi-block file rather
   than mis-resolve it, restoring main's behaviour exactly for that shape.

2. Duplicate CALLS edges reached the graph. phpCallKind splits the per-file
   dedup key, so log() and Logger::log() survive as two relationships. When
   both resolve to the same member, patch-builder salted the edge id by call
   kind and emitted two UpsertEdge ops with identical src, dst and predicate
   but different ids — and the dedup downstream keys on id, so both commit.
   Measured: main 1 op, this branch 2. The salt still applies when the two
   kinds resolve to different nodes, which is what it is for.

Both mutation-tested: each guard removed reds exactly its own test.
